research.title: The brain’s hidden fear mechanism may explain anxiety and PTSD

research.title: Scientists discover that some “unhealthy” diets can boost cancer immunotherapy in mice
research.summary: In a surprising discovery, scientists found that certain diets associated with obesity can make cancer immunotherapy more effective in mice, challenging traditional assumptions about diet and cancer treatment. The findings suggest that the secret may lie in how food interacts with gut bacteria to strengthen the immune system's.

research.title: Scientists find surprisingly little evidence that medical cannabis helps you sleep
research.summary: A major new review challenges the growing enthusiasm for medical cannabis as an insomnia treatment, finding little reliable evidence that it improves sleep quality, sleep duration, or daytime functioning. Researchers caution that this doesn't mean cannabis is ineffective, only that existing studies are too weak to establish whether.
